description: This file defines functions, constants, and types related to secret reference validation and configuration within a project, including patterns for secret IDs, provider resolution, and validation logic.

methods.name: secretRefKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for a given SecretRef object based on its source, provider, and id.

methods.name: resolveDefaultSecretProviderAlias
methods.description: Resolves the default secret provider alias based on configuration, source, and optional preferences.

methods.name: isValidFileSecretRefId
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid file secret reference ID according to defined patterns.

methods.name: isValidSecretProviderAlias
methods.description: Validates if a string matches the secret provider alias pattern.

methods.name: validateExecSecretRefId
methods.description: Validates an execution secret reference ID against pattern and traversal segment rules.

methods.name: isValidExecSecretRefId
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid execution secret reference ID.

methods.name: formatExecSecretRefIdValidationMessage
methods.description: Returns a formatted message explaining the rules for valid execution secret reference IDs.
